text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what actually happened.

**What worked**
Reps reclaimed about 5 hours a week. CRM updates went from "Friday cleanup" to same-day. Managers finally saw what buyers were really saying, not just what reps remembered.

**What surprised us**
Reps who recorded less talked more. Eye contact improved. Discovery questions got sharper because nobody was scrambling to write.

**What we had to fix**
Consent wording in the first 30 seconds mattered. So did a rule that summaries get a 60-second human review before syncing.

**The takeaway**
The tool didn't make reps better sellers. It removed the admin that kept them from selling.

Next quarter: coaching, not just capture.

What did your pilot teach you?
